mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ may be defined as the study of social relationships, social action and social culture."
Sociology may be defined as the study of social relationships, social action and social culture.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of sociology which is mainly concerned with the study of the social and cultural factors affecting the lives of those in rural and agrarian society."
Rural sociology is a branch of sociology which is mainly concerned with the study of the social and cultural factors affecting the lives of those in rural and agrarian society.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an indication of development or change in health sector 3."
Reduction in death rate is an indication of development or change in health sector 3.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the term used to describe a group of people who have had and worked together long enough to get themselves organized and to think of themselves as a social unit."
Society is the term used to describe a group of people who have had and worked together long enough to get themselves organized and to think of themselves as a social unit.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the process by which attraction occurs in the structure and function of a social system."
Social change is the process by which attraction occurs in the structure and function of a social system.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is referred to as attitude change."
A change in attitude is referred to as attitude change.
fib: ______ is the one in which deliberate intervention effort is made to alter existing practice.
Planned change is the one in which deliberate intervention effort is made to alter existing practice.
______ is concerned with charging the knowledge attitudes and practices of large number of rural people.
Extension education is concerned with charging the knowledge attitudes and practices of large number of rural people.
______ is a pattern of relationships among members that hold the group together and help it to assigned goals.
Group structure is a pattern of relationships among members that hold the group together and help it to assigned goals.
______ can be defined as an interaction of complex intra-and inter-personal forces operating in a group which determines its character, development and long term survival.
Group dynamics can be defined as an interaction of complex intra-and inter-personal forces operating in a group which determines its character, development and long term survival.
______ can be defined as several individuals who come together to accomplish a particular task.
A group can be defined as several individuals who come together to accomplish a particular task.

Social indicators are used to measure how the people fare in terms of social provision.
